scope: Spine: a Frame is the core Process with realized claims; runs, reachability, invariants and new realization are defined through the core Trace; the visible scope of an inquiry is the set of configurations its actual executions reach, and a sound policy secures its goal there. Renewal: a run read through observables of conditions is one relational unfolding; an observable that never rises from some step on falls only finitely often, with depletion, recurrent renewal under a natural-number rank and unrenewed drawdown as its cases; in one process from one configuration one run renews and another consumes. Dependence: which conditions a formation depends on, at what level, and which it draws on may change from step to step; constant dependence recovers the static reading exactly; every met dependence is kept or broken across each step; a formation continuing after a loss without return has transformed its dependence, and with fixed dependence it ends; in one process from one configuration the same broken dependence leads to an ending, a transformation and a restoration; a stepwise reading credits an event whose step keeps every dependence on the conditions it participates in, and it and the whole-run reading credit different events in both directions. Metaethical core: on a connected whole with some living claim, significance of every living claim from every standpoint (G0 at claim level) is equivalent to a seed together with relational and standpoint neutrality; the positioned articulation D follows from the articulation premise A; a sound inquiry for new living content gives every position with access a contributory reason; G0, C, D and the secured positive ground are stated in the core, which imports no ethics module. Each of seed, relational neutrality, standpoint neutrality, connection and A has a consistent countermodel, and each rival satisfies the same rule inside a formed boundary. The lifting rule L is transitive only through a live middle response. No premise is proved, no rejecting position is bound, and no duty, ranking, recognition or compliance is inferred. On a run read relationally, a condition in which every living formation participates discharges connection, and without one connection can fail; consumption is a formed relation, so under N_rel valuing a consuming formation's activity reaches the living events of the formation it consumes. Read stepwise, the same discharge holds, and an event drawing at a step that breaks a dependence is related to the broken formation, so under N_rel valuing it reaches that formation's living events. Instances: the core's G0, C, D, secured ground and relational living are by definition those of the existing modules, and J1/J2 on configurations is PracticalJudgment.Better; seed-edge closures and evaluator chains are reachability on the edge process; a frame's reachable configurations form a joint-continuation space whose bundles step-preserving maps carry and lifting summaries reflect; robust responses, guarantees, live steps and evidence narrowing by a rule list are common responses, one-step completion, enabledness and After on a pure observation; the functional articulation of a situation is exactly the deterministic case of the articulation under L, and the lifted comparison, reason, survival and continual-improvement results hold on every frame. A countermodel shows that L is substantive: a response with one better and one worse outcome is comparable in neither direction.
